verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot is built into GitHub and needs no install (github-docs-44). Users can assign coding tasks to the Copilot cloud agent, which researches the repo, plans, makes changes on a branch and opens PRs (github-docs-55, github-docs-26, github-docs-48, github-docs-56). Delegation also extends to mobile task assignment, code reviews and a central agent-session control page (github-docs-4, github-docs-9, github-docs-46). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation, since the only community evidence covers early autocomplete rather than delegated tasks.
